answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the harbor of a task receipt, and the summit is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the forge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, held in escrow until finality, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
